description_blocks.text: Introduction

The Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit is a multifunctional toolkit specifically designed for handheld props, combining lighting, sound, and motion-sensing controls to deliver a personalized, immersive experience. Featuring high-brightness LED strips paired with diffused pearl cotton, it offers smooth and natural lighting effects. An integrated speaker cavity ensures clear audio quality, while the built-in IMU motion sensor captures real-time movements, triggering corresponding light and sound effects for actions like turning on/off, swinging, thrusting, or striking.

The Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit offers two configurations: Kit 01 (Complete Set with LED strips, aluminum alloy tubes, and diffused pearl cotton for large-scale props like the Golden Staff) and Kit 02 (Compact Edition requiring user-provided LED light strip 256RGB 5050LED 815MM, optimized for swords/daggers). Unlike purely aesthetic prop sets that lack hardware, this kit is more than just a prop—it's your creative partner. It supports extensive customization across appearance, lighting effects, and sound effects, compatible with various prop forms such as Golden Staff, Double-Bladed Weapon, and Pixel Lightsaber. Leveraging 3D printing and professional design, it unlocks limitless possibilities for your imagination. With app connectivity, users can easily adjust light colors, flashing frequencies, and even upload custom sound and light effects, creating a one-of-a-kind, personalized prop with ease.
APP Operation
iOS Users: Search for " Frocepark V2 " in the App Store
Android Users: Please scan the QR code to download the app.
Frequently Asked Questions
When installing the batteries, ensure the correct polarity to avoid short circuits.
When connecting the LED strip and button board, be careful not to bend the wires excessively to prevent damage.
Make sure the connectors match the corresponding ports and avoid using excessive force to prevent damage to the interfaces.
Try replacing the charger. A 5V 1A power adapter is recommended. It is not recommended to use a fast charging power adapter.
Use a screwdriver to insert the reset hole and perform a reset operation to restart the system.
Disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and press the reset button on the main board to restart. Ensure the battery connector is connected properly.
Disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and check if the Pixel LED Strip light connections are normal.
Use the mobile phone app to connect to the device via Bluetooth, enter the control menu, check and adjust the volume, and confirm whether the device is muted.
If the problem persists, disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and check if the speaker connections are normal.
Disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and check if the speaker diaphragm is damaged.
If you have replaced the sound effect file, ensure that the audio file format and audio level are correct (44.1KHz 16-bit mono wav).
Check if the battery voltage is too low. Low voltage may cause the device to fail to power on. Please fully charge it before use.
Use a screwdriver to insert the reset hole and try to restart the system.
If ineffective, disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and press the reset button on the main board to restart.
Check if the battery connector is connected properly. Ensure the TF card is inserted correctly. If the above steps do not solve the problem, try updating the firmware.
Please contact us to obtain the latest firmware package and flashing tutorial.
Warning of Lithium Battery
This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. Do not operate the product while it is charging.
Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
Regularly inspect the charger’s cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.
Charging Precautions
Use only the officially supplied charger. The charger is not a toy.

The USB charger for this product only supports standard 5V 1-2A input. Please always use the original charger that meets the voltage/current requirements, or charge directly via a computer USB port. DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A (such as mobile fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, etc.), as this may cause device damage, overheating, or even serious fire hazards.
DO NOT cover the device while charging, and keep it away from high temperature, humidity, or flammable environments. Never charge the device unattended.
DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. Allow it to cool down completely before recharging.
If the battery pack or charger becomes wet, ensure they are thoroughly dry before attempting to charge.
Lithium Battery Safety Precautions
DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.

Frequently Asked Questions

When installing the batteries, ensure the correct polarity to avoid short circuits.

When connecting the LED strip and button board, be careful not to bend the wires excessively to prevent damage.

Make sure the connectors match the corresponding ports and avoid using excessive force to prevent damage to the interfaces.

Try replacing the charger. A 5V 1A power adapter is recommended. It is not recommended to use a fast charging power adapter.

Use a screwdriver to insert the reset hole and perform a reset operation to restart the system.

Disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and press the reset button on the main board to restart. Ensure the battery connector is connected properly.

Disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and check if the Pixel LED Strip light connections are normal.

Use the mobile phone app to connect to the device via Bluetooth, enter the control menu, check and adjust the volume, and confirm whether the device is muted.

If the problem persists, disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and check if the speaker connections are normal.

Disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and check if the speaker diaphragm is damaged.

If you have replaced the sound effect file, ensure that the audio file format and audio level are correct (44.1KHz 16-bit mono wav).

Check if the battery voltage is too low. Low voltage may cause the device to fail to power on. Please fully charge it before use.

Use a screwdriver to insert the reset hole and try to restart the system.

If ineffective, disassemble the aluminum tube, remove the internal structure, and press the reset button on the main board to restart.

Check if the battery connector is connected properly. Ensure the TF card is inserted correctly. If the above steps do not solve the problem, try updating the firmware.

Please contact us to obtain the latest firmware package and flashing tutorial.

Important Notices

Warning of Lithium Battery

  • This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
  • Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. Do not operate the product while it is charging.
  • Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
  • Regularly inspect the charger’s cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
  • Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
  • Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.

Charging Precautions

  • Use only the officially supplied charger. The charger is not a toy.
  • The USB charger for this product only supports standard 5V 1-2A input. Please always use the original charger that meets the voltage/current requirements, or charge directly via a computer USB port. DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A (such as mobile fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, etc.), as this may cause device damage, overheating, or even serious fire hazards.
  • DO NOT cover the device while charging, and keep it away from high temperature, humidity, or flammable environments. Never charge the device unattended.
  • DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. Allow it to cool down completely before recharging.
  • If the battery pack or charger becomes wet, ensure they are thoroughly dry before attempting to charge.

Lithium Battery Safety Precautions

  • DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
  • DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
  • DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
  • Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.
